concepts.gloss_en: Embrace of the right hand (Zohar Pinchas), i.e. the act/state of embracing — head is 'embrace', not the hand itself
Right hand, an aspect of love (ahavah) — the hand itself, not an action upon it

members.note: distinct head; bare 'right hand' equated with love in lm1:67

notes: Different construct heads (חבוק יד ימין = 'embrace of the right hand' vs. יד ימין = 'the right hand' itself). Per rule 4, an action/state about X is not X. Also different Torah contexts (lm1:48 Zohar citation vs. lm1:67). Kept separate.
